title: Write a Commit History That Makes Sense
description: Make three independent changes and record each one as a separate, meaningful commit.
hints: Start with the first change described in utils.py. Once you have made only that change, review the diff, stage that change, and create a commit before touching the next task.
Each commit should represent one logical change. Before committing, check what is staged so you don't accidentally include the helper function or formatting cleanup in the bug-fix commit.

intro.message: Sarah wants this history to be easy to review. There are three small changes to make to utils.py. Keep each change in its own commit.

bugFixCommit.message: Nice. The bug fix has its own commit.

helperCommit.message: Good. The new helper is separated cleanly from the previous change.

formattingCommit.message: Perfect. The formatting cleanup has its own boundary too.

success.message: This is exactly the kind of history I like reviewing. Clean, easy to follow, and easy to revert if needed.

failure.message: The history isn't quite right yet. Check that each logical change has its own commit and that the commits are in the correct order.
